text:
Maya (People Ops): quick sync — planning a Q2 "Small Wins" drop for remote and hybrid folks: desk flags + e-card pairing. want to confirm shipping windows, budget code, and payroll-safe spot-award timing. suggestions?
Diego (Office Ops): love it. timeline? are we doing regional batches or 1 global send?
Maya (People Ops): regional batches preferred (APAC, EMEA, NAM) to stagger customs and courier load. target windows: APAC wk of May 6, EMEA wk of May 13, NAM wk of May 20.
Priya (HRBP): echo regional approach. managers should get a nomination digest 1 week before their regional send. can we make the manager deadline 2 business days before pick?
Maya (People Ops): yes — manager nomination cutoff: 5pm PT on Fri Apr 26 for APAC; May 3 for EMEA; May 10 for NAM. will prod via manager nudge email.
Sam (Finance): budget: estimate per-kit unit cost + shipping. can you drop quantities now? i'll check PO and budget code.
Maya (People Ops): rough counts attached below (heads + 10% buffer). please confirm if that 10% buffer is ok to purchase now.
Joan (People Ops Intern): here are counts I compiled from the headcount export and self-ID tags:
```
Region,Heads,Buffer(10%),OrderQty
APAC,142,14,156
EMEA,198,19,217
NAM,254,25,279
Total,594,58,652
```
Lina (Benefits): two quick asks — 1) any spot awards included in kits should avoid direct monetary equivalents on packaging (to keep tax messaging simple), 2) for international shipments, include a generic "thank you" note not listing award amounts.
Maya (People Ops): good call. e-card will contain the award & amount details (secure), desk flag is just celebratory copy.
Sam (Finance): ok re: packaging. for spot-award payouts tied to these recognitions, payroll cutoff is May 15 for payments processed May 22. if you want payout on schedule, final approval needs to hit finance by May 10.
Priya (HRBP): then managers must finalize approvals by May 9 for NAM sends. can People Ops automate a manager approval flow (simple yes/no) via the nomination form?
Maya (People Ops): yes. I'll add a manager-approval checkbox and an auto-reminder reminder at T-48hrs.
Diego (Office Ops): courier note — for APAC some addresses will require customs paperwork for >$50 value. recommend we mark invoice value as "promotional goods" per courier guidance. Joan, can you flag addresses with known customs issues?
Joan (People Ops Intern): will cross-check addresses flagged in last quarter and annotate a shipping sheet by EOD Thu.
Sam (Finance): also need GL code for procurement: use GL-6102 (Engagement programs) and submit PO via Procure portal. I'll create PO draft and share link.
Maya (People Ops): awesome. action list: 1) Joan: finalize shipping sheet + customs flags (due Thu EOD). 2) Maya: update nomination form with manager-approval + reminders (due Mon). 3) Sam: draft PO + confirm budget code GL-6102 (due Fri). 4) Lina: draft packaging copy (no amounts) + e-card template for secure payout messaging (due next Tue). 5) Priya: send manager comms template for approvals (due Mon).
Priya (HRBP): I can send a short manager script and sample email. will include a TL;DR and where to click to approve.
Diego (Office Ops): logistics question — do we need signature on delivery? i'd prefer no-signature for bulk mail to reduce failed attempts, but higher-value kits might need signature. Thoughts?
Maya (People Ops): let's require signature only for orders marked "high-value" (Joan will flag). otherwise no-signature.
Lina (Benefits): FYI — for some countries small swag counts as taxable fringe; benefits team will send a one-line global tax FAQ to the e-card recipients.
Joan (People Ops Intern): noted. i'll add a column "tax_note_required" in the sheet.
Sam (Finance): once PO is up I'll link invoice payment cadence. prefer net-30 vendor if possible.
Maya (People Ops): great — if everyone is good with the plan i'll lock deadlines by EOD and post a short comms schedule to #general next week. any objections?
Priya (HRBP): none from me. :thumbsup:
Diego (Office Ops): all good. tay to courier team after Joan's sheet.
Lina (Benefits): 👍 no objections.
Joan (People Ops Intern): tracking and will update here as I finish the sheet.
Maya (People Ops): thank you all — will follow up with a concise checklist and the nomination link. cc @here when manager comms is live. :sparkles:
